name: Weakstone
description: Urza's stone, used to try to strengthen the automaton.

description_citations.text: "Warlord of Kroog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra in the Great Desert, take his Weakstone and make him a rakiq.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji took his stone and made him a rakiq (slave)

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A giant mechanical dragon rises from the sands and slays the Qadir and many others; Mishra finds he can control it.
timeline.quote: Mishra found he could directly control the dragon instead

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The peace summit collapses; the Qadir stabs the Yotian Warlord, Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir, and Mishra's Weakstone overloads the automaton.
timeline.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At a second summit Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone; Urza reclaims it and declares war, starting the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: This was the start of the Brothers' War.

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra, with their master Tocasia, explore the sacred cave of Koilos; Urza falls behind in the Hall of Tagsin and finds the Mightstone.
timeline.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

citation.text: Mightstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As children, Tocasia takes the brothers to Koilos, where Mishra discovers the weakstone.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

citation.text: Weakstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers fly Tocasia in the ornithopter, crash near the Caves of Koilos and find two powerstones; each craves both and they begin to mistrust each other.
timeline.quote: Urza takes the Mightstone , and Mishra the Weakstone .

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi enslave Mishra; he sees a Phyrexian realm in a vision, controls a dragon engine with the Weakstone and is accepted by the tribe, later confederating the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Later he can confederate the several Fallaji tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, where the Yawgmoth Demon attacks and follows them back.
timeline.quote: When he uses the Weakstone on the Crystal, a gateway to the other world is opened.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers' rivalry over the halves causes a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death.
timeline.quote: the inadvertent death of Tocasia

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises from the sands and rampages, killing the Qadir; Mishra and Hajar recover the Weakstone and Mishra finds he can control it.
timeline.quote: The Qadir was killed in the confusion.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the contest between the brothers Tocasia is killed and her school is probably destroyed; each keeps one stone.
timeline.quote: As a result of the contest, Tocasia was killed and her school was most likely destroyed.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod cross into Phyrexia through a gate the Weakstone opened in the cave of Koilos.
timeline.quote: we are told earlier that Mishra and Ashnod crossed over into the world of Phyrexia through a gate that the Weakstone opened for them in the cave of Koilos

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him; Urza discovers them, reclaims the stone and declares war.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Life with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed cracks a powerstone in half to open a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Dyfed cracked a large powerstone in half to establish a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec recombines the stones to close the portal and seals Yawgmoth in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: his wife Rebbec discovered Yawgmoth's evil nature and recombined the two halves to close the portal Dyfed had created, sealing him in Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra uncover the stones in the Hall of Tagsin, each taking one, which reactivates the gate to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza took the Mightstone and Mishra the Weakstone, unwittingly reactivating the gate to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tocasia, Urza and Mishra fly to the Thran city Koilos, find a great machine, and an explosion leaves each brother holding half of the powerstone.
timeline.quote: each brother was holding a half of the great stone in their hand

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra, enslave him and take his Weakstone.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi, a militant faction of the Fallaji, who enslaved him

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises and slays the Qadir; Mishra retrieves the Weakstone and discovers he can control the dragon.
timeline.quote: Mishra found he could directly control it instead

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mishra seduces Kayla into stealing Urza's Mightstone at the Kroog peace talks; Urza reclaims it and Mishra flees.
timeline.quote: he convinced Kayla to sleep with him and steal Urza's Mightstone

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 36 AR Gix is summoned to Mishra's Fortress, is burned by the Weakstone and decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
timeline.quote: seeking instead to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tocasia takes Urza and Mishra, about sixteen, on a pilgrimage to the Caves of Koilos where they find the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: Urza discovered the Mightstone, and Mishra, the Weakstone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers break the powerstone sealing Phyrexia in two, and Tocasia dies inadvertently in the resulting Brotherhood's End.
timeline.quote: in their haste to grab the stone before the other brother, they broke it in two

citation.text: "Urza", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the moment of the blast Urza meets Teferi beyond time, his body is remade with the Mightstone and Weakstone as eyes, and his spark ignites.
timeline.quote: igniting his latent planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Urza", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Urza and Mishra reach for the powerstone it explodes, splitting into two halves.
timeline.quote: when Mishra and Urza reach for the stone it explodes, splitting it into two halves

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza survives the blast and ascends as a planeswalker with his eyes replaced by the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: Urza survives the Sylex blast and ascends, becoming a planeswalker

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard places Urza's powerstone eyes into Karn; the Legacy destroys the Phyrexians and Yawgmoth, and Karn becomes the first artificial planeswalker.
timeline.quote: the powerstones turned Karn into the first artificial planeswalker

citation.text: "Karn", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza reveals his gem eyes and fades away, quoting Kayla's message to remember him as he tried to be; Tawnos walks inland as snow begins to fall.
timeline.quote: As you were, but as you tried to be,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Power from the Weakstone binds a dragon engine to Mishra's command.
timeline.quote: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.

citation.text: Mishra's Domination (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza uses the Golgothian Sylex to obliterate Mishra and his army, levels Argoth, and becomes a planeswalker as the stones merge into his eyes.
timeline.quote: Urza used the Golgothian Sylex to obliterate his brother and his army.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Reunification in Urza, Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radiant plucks the stones from Urza's eyes in Serra's Sanctum and dies when she puts them together, restoring Urza.
timeline.quote: Radiant then foolishly put the two stones together, triggering an explosion that killed the angel and restored Urza.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Reunification in Urza, Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard combines the stones inside Karn's chest, driving Yawgmoth from Dominaria, killing Gerrard and making Karn a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: triggering a burst of energy that drove Yawgmoth from Dominaria while killing Gerrard and causing Karn to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos, and the brothers split a powerstone, creating the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: The brothers split a Thran powerstone , accidentally creating the Mightstone and Weakstone .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix finds he cannot murder Mishra and steal the Weakstone, and decides to corrupt Mishra for Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gix decided to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra's Fortress", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza's avenger chokes the Qadir until Ashnod weakens it; Urza's Mightstone and Mishra's Weakstone overload it and it explodes.
timeline.quote: The opposite forces overloaded the Avenger, making it explode.

citation.text: "Peace Summit at Korlinda", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
